verdict.rationale: Bruno documents serving realistic mock responses while building (bruno-docs-4), and its environment selector and runtime environment-variable overrides (bruno-docs-13, bruno-docs-11) imply you can point runs at a non-production target. The CLI's Safe Mode is script-execution sandboxing, an adjacent control that is not credited here. missing for 10: dedicated docs on mock-server setup and depth, explicit docs on configuring separate sandbox vs production environments, any safeguard against accidentally hitting production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
